value.rationale: For a natural full interval-placement family of generating partitions of the canonical expanding circle endomorphism, the complete joint law of observations is identically iid, yet almost-sure information preservation has a sharp, unique defect. This makes precise the difference between statistical independence and generating observation. The proof supplies a usable finite-block decoder with an explicit exponential waiting-time tail for every dyadic placement except the quarter cut, and a complete two-to-one fiber classification at the exception; these are natural, motivated structural invariants, not arbitrary numerics.
